programmes.st: Phoney Phone Calls / Heavy Metal Fraud
programmes.d: In the late 1990s, Slobodan Lunic is the owner and operator of Pay Tel, a Chicago-based company offering investors an opportunity to purchase payphones and with partner Scott Holmberg takes in thousands of investors and collects nearly $40 million. And Luis Ferreira is running a South Florida precious metal brokerage, Spyker Consulting, though really a front for a fraudulent telemarketing scam.
